title: Preparation of Whole-mount Mouse Islets on Vascular Extracellular Matrix for Live Islet Cell Microscopy
author: Kung-Hsien Ho
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Atlanta Biologicals, catalog number: S
Nalgene TM Rapid-Flow TM Sterile Disposable Filter Units, 0.2 μm PES membrane (Thermo Fisher Scientific, catalog number: 569-
Hanks’ Balanced Salt Solution with calcium & magnesium (HBSS) (Gibco, catalog number: 21-020-CV) Collagenase from Clostridium histolyticum (Millipore Sigma, catalog number: C5138, lot number:
Islet media (see Recipes) Collagenase solution (see Recipes) ECM coating solution (see Recipes)

Recipes Islet media RPMI-1640 (the media contains 11 mM glucose) 10% heat-inactivated FBS 100 U/mL penicillin-100 mg/mL streptomycin Filter the media through a 0.2 μm PES membrane, store at 4 °C, and used within one month of preparation. Collagenase solution 0.5 mg/mL collagenase in HBSS Store aliquots (1 mL) of the prepared solution at -20 °C for up to one year. ECM coating solution 9 μg/mL ECM in islet media Store aliquots (100 μL) of the prepared solution at -20 °C for up to two years.

steps.title: Prepare media and solutions
steps.instruction: Make three solutions as described and store them under the indicated conditions.

substeps.instruction: Islet media: RPMI‑1640 (11 mM glucose) + 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS + 100 U/mL penicillin + 100 mg/mL streptomycin; filter through a 0.2 µm PES membrane, store at 4 °C and use within one month.
Collagenase solution: dissolve collagenase to 0.5 mg/mL in HBSS; aliquot 1 mL portions and store at –20 °C for up to one year.
ECM coating solution: dilute ECM to 9 µg/mL in islet media; aliquot 100 µL portions and store at –20 °C for up to two years.

steps.title: Inject pancreas with collagenase
steps.instruction: Introduce collagenase solution into the mouse pancreas via the common bile duct.

substeps.instruction: Load 2 mL of the prepared collagenase solution into a 5 mL syringe.
Attach a 27 G ½″ needle (or a 30 G ½″ needle for smaller mice) and inject the solution through the common bile duct.

steps.title: Digest pancreas at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Enzymatically dissociate the pancreas in a water bath.

substeps.instruction: Place the injected pancreas in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 16 min, applying gentle shaking every 4 min.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Remove enzymes and collect the islet-containing fraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of chilled islet media per pancreas and shake vigorously.
Centrifuge at 700 × g for 2 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Hand‑pick islets
steps.instruction: Isolate intact islets under a dissection scope.

substeps.instruction: Using a P20 pipette with 200 µL tips, transfer islets to a 60 mm Petri dish containing islet media.
Repeat the picking three times to separate islets from acinar tissue.

steps.title: Incubate isolated islets
steps.instruction: Maintain the freshly isolated islets in a humidified incubator.

substeps.instruction: Place the dish in a water‑jacketed incubator set to 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Plasma‑clean MatTek dish
steps.instruction: Prepare the glass coverslip for ECM coating.

substeps.instruction: Remove the lid of a 35 mm MatTek dish that contains a 10 mm microwell.
Insert the dish into the plasma cleaner, seal the chamber, set the RF level to medium, and run the plasma for 1 min.
Replace the lid immediately after cleaning.

steps.title: Apply ECM coating
steps.instruction: Deposit a thin layer of ECM onto the center of the coverslip.

substeps.instruction: Using a P100 pipette, dispense ~5 µL of the ECM coating solution onto the center of the coverslip.
Smear the droplet with the pipette tip, then retract excess solution back into the tip to avoid a thick layer.

steps.title: Create humidified chamber
steps.instruction: Assemble a moisture‑rich environment for the MatTek dish.

substeps.instruction: Cover the MatTek dish with its own lid.
Place the dish on the lid of a 150 mm culture dish.
Add a sheet of tissue wiper wetted with distilled water to the bottom of the 150 mm dish and position the MatTek dish so the tissue sits at the top of the chamber.

steps.title: Incubate for ECM attachment
steps.instruction: Allow the ECM to bind to the glass surface.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the assembled chamber at 37 °C in the water‑jacketed incubator for 10 min.

steps.title: Wash coated coverslip
steps.instruction: Remove unbound ECM from the microwell.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of islet media into the microwell and aspirate it from the edge that is not coated.

steps.title: Refill microwell with media
steps.instruction: Restore the culture volume while preserving surface tension.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of fresh islet media to the microwell, keeping the liquid confined inside the well.

steps.title: Transfer islets to microwell
steps.instruction: Place isolated islets onto the ECM‑coated area.

substeps.instruction: Under a dissection scope, use a P20 pipette to move 1–2 islets to the center of the microwell.

steps.title: Incubate islets for two days
steps.instruction: Allow islets to attach and begin flattening.

substeps.instruction: Return the MatTek dish to the humidified chamber and incubate at 37 °C for 2 days.
Do not change media during this period; add fresh media only as described later.
Select islets smaller than 120 µm in diameter for optimal dye penetration.

steps.title: Add fresh media on day 2
steps.instruction: Supplement the culture without disturbing attached islets.

substeps.instruction: Gently dispense 150 µL of islet media from the edge of the microwell under a dissection scope.
Do not remove the existing media before adding the fresh volume.

steps.title: Incubate until day 4
steps.instruction: Continue culture after the day‑2 media addition.

substeps.instruction: Keep the dish in the incubator for an additional 2 days (total of 4 days).

steps.title: Add media on day 4
steps.instruction: Provide a larger volume of fresh media for later imaging.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 500 µL of islet media from the edge of the microwell; the media will overflow onto the plastic dish bottom.
Note that the MatTek dish can hold up to 2 mL of media.

steps.title: Proceed to imaging (days 4‑6)
steps.instruction: Perform live microscopy on the firmly attached islets.

substeps.instruction: Islets remain attached from day 4 through day 6 and are suitable for confocal or TIRF microscopy.
